description: Vertical Instagram lip-sync reel. The identity woman looks straight into camera, mouthing: No, I don't think you understand. I'm obsessed. A white text bubble pops over her shoulder naming the outcome: this new set. Cut to a three-quarter shot from behind in a white button-down and high-waist black trousers, hip cocked, braid over her left shoulder, then back to a calm close-up. Photorealistic phone video, not CGI.
style: Instagram lip-sync reel, handheld-but-stable, photorealistic, no CGI, no product explosion
camera: 9:16 vertical. Start on a tight face close-up, hold for the first line, pull to a mid-thigh three-quarter from behind, end on a face close-up
lighting: Bright even studio-style front light, soft shadows, off-white wall
location: Plain off-white studio wall, same setting as the face identity still
atmosphere: Calm, direct, a little teasing. No fog, no particles, no neon
identity_lock: Same adult woman as face-source and body-source
Medium-tan complexion, large dark eyes, small nose stud, full lips
Long dark brown hair with wispy bangs, thick braid over the left shoulder
Hourglass figure, slim waist, wide hips, fully clothed
outfit: Crisp white long-sleeve button-down tucked into high-waist black trousers, thin gold chain.
sound: notmonica Original Audio. Lip-sync only; do not generate burned-in captions besides the one text bubble.
lip_sync_line: No, I don't think you understand. I'm obsessed.
elements: 0.0–1.2s: tight face close-up, she starts the line, eyes on lens
1.2–3.5s: she finishes I'm obsessed, a white rounded text bubble appears over her left shoulder reading this new set
3.5–6.5s: cut to three-quarter from behind, hip cocked, braid over left shoulder, white shirt and black trousers, she glances back at camera
6.5–8.0s: return to face close-up, small smile, hold
motion: Natural talking-head lip-sync, one clean cut to the over-shoulder body beat, no whip pans, no particle FX
cta_motion: No logo. Hold the last close-up so a Follow sticker can be added in Instagram.
ending: Face close-up, braid visible, gold chain catching the light, text bubble already gone
text: Single on-screen bubble: this new set. No other captions, no hashtags in frame.
